proof_body:
by
  intro ω y v hω hy hv t
  have hb : ∀ u : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ω * s) (ω * 1) u :=
    fun u => (hasDerivAt_id u).const_mul ω
  have hA : ∀ u, HasDerivAt (fun u => y u * Real.cos (ω * u) - v u / ω * Real.sin (ω * u)) 0 u := by
    intro u
    have h : HasDerivAt (fun u => y u * Real.cos (ω * u) - v u / ω * Real.sin (ω * u))
        (v u * Real.cos (ω * u) + y u * (-Real.sin (ω * u) * (ω * 1)) -
          (-(ω ^ 2 * y u) / ω * Real.sin (ω * u) +
            v u / ω * (Real.cos (ω * u) * (ω * 1)))) u :=
      ((hy u).mul (hb u).cos).sub (((hv u).div_const ω).mul (hb u).sin)
    refine h.congr_deriv ?_
    field_simp
    ring
  have hB : ∀ u, HasDerivAt (fun u => y u * Real.sin (ω * u) + v u / ω * Real.cos (ω * u)) 0 u := by
    intro u
    have h : HasDerivAt (fun u => y u * Real.sin (ω * u) + v u / ω * Real.cos (ω * u))
        (v u * Real.sin (ω * u) + y u * (Real.cos (ω * u) * (ω * 1)) +
          (-(ω ^ 2 * y u) / ω * Real.cos (ω * u) +
            v u / ω * (-Real.sin (ω * u) * (ω * 1)))) u :=
      ((hy u).mul (hb u).sin).add (((hv u).div_const ω).mul (hb u).cos)
    refine h.congr_deriv ?_
    field_simp
    ring
  have hA0 : y t * Real.cos (ω * t) - v t / ω * Real.sin (ω * t) = y 0 := by
    have h := is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (fun u => (hA u).differentiableAt)
      (fun u => (hA u).deriv) t 0
    simpa using h
  have hB0 : y t * Real.sin (ω * t) + v t / ω * Real.cos (ω * t) = v 0 / ω := by
    have h := is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (fun u => (hB u).differentiableAt)
      (fun u => (hB u).deriv) t 0
    simpa using h
  rw [← hA0, ← hB0]
  linear_combination (-y t) * Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq (ω * t)
target_source: ∀ (ω : ℝ) (y v : ℝ → ℝ), ω ≠ 0 → (∀ t, HasDerivAt y (v t) t) → (∀ t, HasDerivAt v (-(ω ^ 2 * y t)) t) → ∀ t, y t = y 0 * Real.cos (ω * t) + v 0 / ω * Real.sin (ω * t)
